self-identify.translation:
自我认同
自我认定

self-images.translation: (self-image 的复数) n. 自我形象

self-immolating.translation: adj. 自我牺牲的；自我毁灭的

self-immolations.translation: (self-immolation 的复数) n. 自我牺牲

self-importance.definition:
n an inflated feeling of pride in your superiority to others
n an exaggerated opinion of your own importance

self-important.definition: s having or showing feelings of unwarranted importance out of overbearing pride
self-important.translation: a. 自尊心极强的, 妄自尊大的

self-importantly.translation: 高傲地; 妄自尊大地

self-imposed.translation: a. 自愿接受的, 自愿承担的

self-improvement.definition: n. the act of improving yourself
self-improvement.translation: n. 自我改善, 自我修养

self-improvements.definition:
plural of self-improvement
n. the act of improving yourself
self-improvements.translation: (self-improvement 的复数) n. 自我改善, 自我修养

self-improver.translation: n. 自我改善；自我修养 (self-improvement的变形)

self-improvers.translation: (self-improver 的复数) n. 自我改善；自我修养 (self-improvement的变形)

self-inclusive.translation: a. 包括自己在内的, 包括本身的； 自身完整的

self-incrimination.definition: n. an accusation that incriminates yourself
self-incrimination.translation:
n. 自证其罪
[法] 自证其罪, 自认犯罪, 自我牵连

self-induced.definition:
a. produced by electrical self-induction
s. brought about by yourself
self-induced.translation: a. 自诱导的, 自感应的

self-inductance.definition: n the ratio of the electromotive force produced in a circuit by self-induction to the rate of change of current producing it, expressed in henries
self-inductance.translation:
n. 自身电感, 自感
[化] 自感

self-inductances.definition:
plural of self-inductance
n the ratio of the electromotive force produced in a circuit by self-induction to the rate of change of current producing it, expressed in henries
self-inductances.translation:
(self-inductance 的复数) n. 自身电感, 自感
[化] 自感

self-induction.definition: n generation of an electromotive force (EMF) in a circuit by changing the current in that circuit; usually measured in henries
self-induction.translation: n. 自诱导, 自感应

self-indulgence.definition:
n an inability to resist the gratification of whims and desires
n excess in action and immoderate indulgence of bodily appetites, especially in passion or indulgence
self-indulgence.translation:
n. 放纵, 任性
[法] 自我放纵

self-indulgences.definition:
plural of self-indulgence
n an inability to resist the gratification of whims and desires
n excess in action and immoderate indulgence of bodily appetites, especially in passion or indulgence
self-indulgences.translation:
(self-indulgence 的复数) n. 放纵, 任性
[法] 自我放纵

self-indulgent.definition: s. indulgent of your own appetites and desires
self-indulgent.translation: a. 放纵的, 任性的

self-indulgently.translation: 任性地; 自我放纵地

self-inflicted.translation:
a. 加于自身的
[法] 自使蒙受的, 自己造成的

self-initiated.translation: adj. 从自我开始的；自己发起的，自创的

self-injuries.translation: (self-injury 的复数) [法] 自害, 自伤

self-insurance.definition: n insuring yourself by setting aside money to cover possible losses rather than by purchasing an insurance policy

self-insure.translation: vi. 实行自我保险, 自保

self-interactions.translation: (self-interaction 的复数)  自身相互反应

self-interest.definition:
n taking advantage of opportunities without regard for the consequences for others
n concern for your own interests and welfare
self-interest.translation:
n. 利己主义, 私利
[法] 自私自利, 利己

self-interested.definition:
a. Particularly concerned for one's own interest or
   happiness.
self-interested.translation: a. 利己主义的, 自私的

self-interests.definition:
plural of self-interest
n taking advantage of opportunities without regard for the consequences for others
n concern for your own interests and welfare
self-interests.translation:
(self-interest 的复数) n. 利己主义, 私利
[法] 自私自利, 利己

self-involved.definition: s absorbed in your own interests or thoughts etc

self-iofection.translation: [医] 自体传染, 自体感染

self-ionization.translation: [化] 自电离; 自电离作用
